meta.title: Marvel Earth-616 Explorer
meta.scope: Earth-616 comics, with clearly marked relocated characters; recorded history, not current rosters
meta.disclaimer: Curated and non-exhaustive. All links represent historical relationships; era labels do not establish start/end dates. Broad reference links are flagged for issue-level follow-up. No MCU-only versions are merged.
meta.schema: v1 nodes/edges/sources backwards compatible with v0.2 mobile UI
meta.change_log: Synchronized canonical relationship research people, identities, publisher sources, and evidence-backed interpersonal connections into broad explorer; coarse edge types retain directed dimensions in notes.
meta.research_quality: Source links refer to official Marvel character/issue guides. High confidence on issue-specific roster events; broad sources explicitly labeled issue-level verification pending.
